heading: Cable Tester
bottomHtml:
Professional Cable Tester – Accurate Network & LAN Cable Testing for Reliable Installations

Ensure your network installations are error-free with our high-precision Cable Tester, designed for quickly identifying faults, shorts, miswires, and open circuits in Ethernet, LAN, RJ45, RJ11, and coaxial cables. Ideal for network technicians, IT professionals, and DIY users, this essential tool helps you verify cable integrity before deployment.

Key Features:

  • Wide Compatibility: Supports testing of RJ45 (Cat5e/Cat6), RJ11, and BNC cables.

  • Easy-to-Read Indicators: LED lights display wiring status and pin configuration clearly.

  • Portable Design: Lightweight and compact—perfect for on-site or in-office use.

  • Battery Operated: Convenient for remote testing without power supply.

  • Master & Remote Unit: Test both ends of long cables with ease.

Whether you're installing a new network or troubleshooting existing lines, our Cable Tester offers fast, accurate results to save time and reduce installation errors.
